pages.title: A place for relics
pages.text: “What is hidden well is not lost, not even to death.”$(br2)The progression window (key $(thing)H$()) has a $(thing)Vault$() section after “Placement”. Items in its cells work as if you were wearing them and $(#1C7FA8)are not lost on death$(). All of this mod's artifacts live here: a cell replaces separate accessory slots.

pages.title: Cells
pages.text: You start with no cells. Unlock them with experience levels: $(thing)the N-th cell costs N levels$().$(br2)$(#1C7FA8)Artifacts:$() one cell for every equippable artifact (7 for now).$(br)$(#1C7FA8)Gear:$() up to 6 cells: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, main hand and off hand.$(br2)When a new artifact appears, one more cell is added for it.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text: Click an inventory item, then a cell. $(thing)Shift + click$() puts it in the first free cell. Clicking a filled cell returns the item. Right click clears the selection.$(br2)Each cell has two icons: the $(#1C7FA8)eye$() (show the item on your character) and the $(#1C7FA8)power$() icon (turns the item's effect on and off).$(br2)Swapping is blocked for $(thing)10 seconds$() after combat (the $(thing)vaultCombatSeconds$() option; 0 disables the lock).

pages.title: Artifacts
pages.text: An artifact works while it sits in a cell. One artifact takes one cell, so duplicates do not stack and the effect is never doubled.$(br2)All of this mod's artifacts work from the hands, armor slots or vault cells, including $(l:resources/beyond/soul_memory)Soul Memory$(/l) and Fenton's Bracelet.

pages.title: Gear
pages.text: Armor in cells is $(thing)shown on your character$() and drawn over worn armor. The $(#1C7FA8)eye$() icon next to a cell hides it.$(br2)Armor stats are added when the matching slot on your character is $(thing)empty$() (vanilla protection enchantments do not count). $(#1C7FA8)Effects of this mod's items$(), such as the Armor of the Beyond, always work, even if you wear other armor.

pages.title: Hands
pages.text: Hand cells draw nothing. Their items work only while your real main hand is $(thing)empty$().$(br2)$(#1C7FA8)Main hand, Scythe of the Beyond:$() its charge grows from any kill, and souls $(thing)never appear$() while it is on, even when the charge is full. To get souls, $(thing)turn the Scythe's power off$(). To activate its effects $(thing)hold right click for 3 seconds$(). You can still be a Ghost.$(br2)$(#1C7FA8)Off hand, Soul Catcher:$() $(thing)Shift + right click$() on a mob catches it, $(thing)Shift + holding right click$() (5 seconds) absorbs the soul. A soul cannot be released from the vault.$(br2)The power icon turns all these effects off.
